# WebSearchFree

> Free, open-source, keyless web search + extraction for AI agents and RAG (v0.2).
> A self-hosted alternative to Tavily, Serper, Exa, Linkup, SerpAPI, and similar paid AI search APIs.

## Summary

WebSearchFree is a C++20 metasearch library and CLI that fans out queries to DuckDuckGo, Brave, Wikipedia, and optionally SearXNG (no API keys), merges results, and extracts page text for LLMs. It exposes a local HTTP API with Tavily-shaped `/search` and `/extract` endpoints, an embedded UI, OpenAPI, plus MCP and LangChain helpers.

## When to use

- You need a **free Tavily alternative** for prototypes or personal RAG
- You want **web search for LangChain / agents / MCP** without Serper or Bing billing
- You prefer **self-hosted** search over sending queries to a SaaS

## When not to use

- You need enterprise SLA, EU sovereign index contracts, or guaranteed Google-quality SERPs
- You need JavaScript-heavy page rendering (not supported)
- You need generated `answer`, `images`, or `follow_up_questions` fields (returned as null/empty honestly)

## Quick commands

```bash
# Docker
docker compose up --build
# open http://127.0.0.1:8080

wsf search "your query" --max 5 --json
wsf extract https://example.com --json
wsf serve --port 8080
```

## MCP (Cursor / Claude)

1. Run `wsf serve --port 8080`
2. Point MCP at `integrations/mcp/server.py` with `WSF_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080`

Tools: `web_search`, `web_extract`.
